selection_rationale: MotorCalculator has no radial-flux topology in its input schema, so the first reference must come from the axial-flux family it actually models. Within that family the coreless single-stator dual-rotor machine is the only variant whose analytical magnetic circuit corresponds to exactly one physical geometry, needs no invented B-H curve, and stays linear.
